item.title: 4 hospitalized, including FedEx employees, following hazardous material exposure in Concord
item.description: Two FedEx employees and two firefighters are hospitalized after being exposed to a hazardous material in Concord on Monday, fire officials said.

item.title: 'Daredevil: Born Again' premiere held in New York City ahead of new season on Disney+
item.description: Monday night was the big premiere in New York City ahead of the first episode on Tuesday.

item.title: SF driver who killed family of 4 will be forced to explain what happened in crash in civil cases
item.description: During the criminal case, 80-year-old Mary Fong Lau was not required to take the stand and explain why her car plowed into the bus stop where a mother, father, and their two young kids were waiting. But during the civil lawsuits, she will be required to explain what happened and the family of the victims hope that leads to some answers about their tragic deaths.

item.title: Lafayette homicide victim ID'd, suspect in custody as bizarre Facebook post surfaces
item.description: Sheriff's officials say 34-year-old Christopher Jaber was killed by a suspect who appears to have known him. The investigation remains ongoing as a suspicious Facebook post targeting the victim is coming to light.

item.title: Preliminary magnitude 7.6 earthquake strikes near Tonga in the South Pacific Ocean, USGS says
item.description: A strong preliminary magnitude 7.6 earthquake struck near Tonga in the South Pacific Ocean, prompting coastal evacuations but no wider tsunami warnings.

item.title: Senators consider deal to fund Homeland Security but not ICE enforcement as airport lines snarl
item.description: "All I can say is that the discussions have been very positive and productive, and hopefully headed in the right direction," said Senate Majority Leader John Thune, R-S.D.

item.title: Dog reunited with family 11 years after being stolen from backyard in Philadelphia
item.description: After more than decade apart, a dog that was stolen from a Philadelphia backyard was reunited with his family in an emotional and heartwarming moment.

item.title: San Jose residents plagued by mail theft with stolen master keys amid ongoing investigation
item.description: Concerned residents have been reporting issues of mail theft in San Jose, where thieves have been using master keys to steal credit cards, checks and other important mail.

item.title: Foster City declares emergency after cyberattack forces city computer system offline for days
item.description: Following a ransomware attack, Foster City officials say they took most of their computer systems offline as a precaution after discovering suspicious activity. Days later, the issue is still ongoing and public services remain limited.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Mild spring temperatures continue with sunny skies
item.description: Our mild spring weather continues today. Daytime highs are still running above average by 10 to 15 degrees. Under sunny skies highs reach the upper 60s to the mid 80s.
